newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-PACERS CENTER SMITS EXPECTED TO PLAY FIRST GAME THIS SEASON.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-PACERS CENTER SMITS EXPECTED TO PLAY FIRST GAME THIS SEASON.

text.p: Indiana Pacers centre Rik Smits has been activated from the injured list and is expected to play in his first game of the season Tuesday night when the Pacers host the Cleveland Cavaliers.
Smits underwent surgery for compression of nerves in both feet on September 9 and missed training camp and the first two months of the season.
The Pacers were 14-16 without the Dutchman and stand in seventh place in the Central Division.
The 7-foot-4 (2.24 m), 265-pound (120 kg) Smits missed 19 games due to foot problems last season. He averaged 18.5 points and 6.9 rebounds in 63 games.
The Pacers placed guard Fred Hoiberg on the injured list to make room on the roster for Smits.
